the-male-lead-chooses-the-forgotten-side:
From the moment she could remember, Vivienne had known that something in her life was terribly wrong.
At first, it was nothing more than a feeling—an unshakable, suffocating unease that clung to her chest like invisible chains.
As she grew older, she came to understand the truth.
…This world was nothing more than a meticulously crafted plot.
A narrative controlled by some unseen force.
A story in which every life unfolded according to the will of that power.
And her role?
She was nothing but a secondary villain.
A detestable character, despised by all.
Fated for a pitiful and tragic end.
Vivienne Blackwood refused to surrender to such a script. She refused to relinquish her right to choose—her right to live her own life.
So she fought.
She tried to escape the plot, to break free from that suffocating destiny…
But it was useless.
She tried to prevent her parents’ deaths…
In vain.
She tried to change her future, burying herself in relentless study day and night to earn a place in a prestigious medical university…
In vain.
She even tried to stay away from the protagonist of this world…
In vain.…
the-players-pov:
Question: If one day, you woke up and realized that you were in a novel, or a game that you know, how would you survive?
Answer: It's simple, just follow the fucking main character.
“…Really…?”
Opening his eyes again, Kael, a streamer, found himself in another world.
He had been transmigrated.
And this should have been a happy thing.
But no.
He had been transmigrated into the most difficult game in human history.
Tower of Glory.
“Fuck. Am I that unlucky? What are the chances?”
But that wasn’t the worst part.
Kael was just an outsider, not a 5-star, or even a 4-star character.
Worse yet, he didn’t even have an Ability.
The ability to know the future was the only thing he had, but if he wasn’t strong enough, it wouldn’t be of any use.
So, what should Kael do?
The answer was simple.
Accompanied the protagonist.
Just by being with him, his chances of survival could easily reach 99.999%.
Kael Draven - a Transmigrator.
Hans Varun - the main character of Tower of Glory - a Regressor.
The two of them had no connection to each other.
They had different missions and purposes.
They came from two separate worlds.
But, they could still become the best teammates.
Even best friends.
the-reincarnators-system-building-a-hare:
In his previous life, Adrian was a brilliant but powerless man, a business man and political analyst who understood how empires rose and fell but never had the chance to build one himself.
He died with regret, and woke as the newborn son of Count Raga Vane, lord of Ashenmere County, a rural backwater at the fringe of the Kingdom of Valdris.
For eleven years, Aldric played the quiet, studious child. Then his father was poisoned by agents of a rival noble house, and everything changed.
On the night of his father’s death, the System awakened: the Sovereign’s Eye, a power that lets Aldric see the true talents, potential, and hidden attributes of anyone he observes.
Now Aldric must survive, inherit, and transform. His county is poor, his vassals are uncertain, his neighbors smell blood.
But Aldric can see what no one else can: the blacksmith’s daughter who could become the greatest swordmaster of a generation.
The beggar boy with latent S-Rank magical aptitude. The disgraced merchant woman whose financial genius could fund an army.
One by one, he finds them, recruits them, and gives them a reason to follow an eleven-year-old lord with impossible ambition.
the-sss-rank-deveror-who-abandoned-glory:
Cidd Ashen died alone at his desk in another world. No family. No friends. Nobody noticed until Monday morning. His second life wasn't much different. Reincarnated into the world of Anastacia, he spent two years as the invisible backbone of the hero party — doing everything, getting nothing, while the golden-haired hero Aldric took every bow and every credit. At twelve years old he was told he was useless and asked to leave. He raised his fist. He stopped. He walked away into the dark without looking back.
One year later he was S rank. One of four in the entire world. Not because of talent. Not because of cheat skills from sympathetic gods. Because of World Gain — the ability to take a monster's skill after killing it and evolve it through sheer hard work into something uniquely, terrifyingly his own. And because the man behind the ability never stopped working, never stopped learning, never stopped being exactly who he was regardless of whether anyone was watching.
Then a dragon destroyed a village. His fault. His mistake. His dragon that he didn't finish. In the rubble he found four newborn girls with no one left in the world. He picked them up.…

…

Have you ever seen a cat… turning into a little kid?
.....

But when cat eared little girl suddenly grew up into an adult… Kyle fell silent.
